profile_text.body:
Aurora Innovation, Inc. is a public company headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, trading under the ticker AUR. Its website describes self-driving freight powered by the Aurora Driver, which the company says combines hardware and software backed by verifiable AI to integrate autonomy into trucking fleets. The site frames the work as delivering the benefits of self-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly.

The site presents the Aurora Driver as a system for autonomous trucking, with quoted partners describing pilot operations. One quote cites autonomous hauling of freight between Fort Worth and El Paso under a hybrid model of professional drivers and the Aurora Driver. Another says the Aurora Driver is integrated into the Volvo VNL Autonomous, and a third refers to millions of autonomous miles of performance.

The company's record shows no tracked products, lawsuits, or MCP servers. It is recorded as a for-profit public company with Pennsylvania as its law exposure location, at a count of 176.
